about_the_game: In a medieval fantasy world brimming with magical monsters, sorcery, and rare enchanted relics, you inherit your eccentric uncle’s old, crumbling shop filled with dust, mystery, and forgotten relics. You are not a mighty warrior, a legendary mage, or a gallant knight—you are a savvy merchant with a keen eye for value and a silver tongue for haggling.
detailed_description:
Step into Pawn & Roll

As the new owner, it's up to you to restore the store to its former glory—appraise, buy,  and sell enchanted items to a variety of customers: from adventurers to rare VIP monsters and sorcerers. Repair, upgrade, and decorate your shop to attract rare clients with legendary artifacts to sell. Navigate a dynamic economy, uncover hidden secrets, and build your reputation as the best merchant in the realm, with just a few rolls of dice. Can you turn a forgotten corner store into a magical emporium?

Become the ultimate arcane merchant!

In this “try-your-luck” simulator game, you’ll take on the role of a shopkeeper specializing in buying, identifying, and selling magical items of all kinds. From cursed amulets to dragon-forged swords, potions brewed by witches to relics once belonging to forgotten gods—your inventory will never be short of wonders. But beware: not every item is what it seems, and not every buyer is who they claim to be.

Master the art of the deal

Each day brings a new wave of customers, each with unique personalities, desires, and quirks. Bargain, bluff, or charm your way to the best prices—just make sure you're not being tricked yourself. With customers remembering past encounters, will you risk angering your best client for a chance to buy that epic frozen bow?  

Build and customize your shop

Start with a humble, dusty, and almost empty shop and work your way up to owning a luxurious emporium in the bustling capital city. Hire valuable employees, upgrade your store’s appearance, expand its size, and decorate it to attract wealthier clients and rare item hunters. The better your shop, the more valuable items you’ll encounter—and the more powerful and demanding your clientele will become.

Uncover the mysteries behind each item

Every object you buy has a past. Use your growing expertise—or hire skilled appraisers, mages, and enchanters—to analyze your inventory. Discover secret enchantments, hidden curses, or valuable histories that can drastically increase an item's worth… or make it too dangerous to handle if it is cursed. Knowing what’s real and what’s fake or cursed is crucial to surviving in this competitive world.

Face events, rivals, and random encounters

Outside your shop walls, the world moves on. A king’s decree, a magical catastrophe, a dwarf festival week, or a war between guilds can shift item prices or flood the market with strange goods.Thieves,  pests, and magical inspectors may impact in your shops reputation, while unexpected visitors—like wandering adventurers or retired heroes—may offer legendary items, rare knowledge, or sinister deals.

Live your merchant fantasy

As you rise through the ranks of the merchant world, you’ll build a reputation not only for your profits but for your decisions. Will you run a clean and noble business, or deal in forbidden artifacts and shady deals?

Are you ready to begin your journey into the Adventurer’s Shop?

If you’ve ever dreamed of trading legendary items, matching wits with clever buyers, and building your fortune not through combat, but through charm and cunning, this is the game for you. Every deal is a story, and every day brings new surprises.
